main.description: Plain send by a nameless worker under its desk's pass. No bearer token: the worker signs the request and the plaintext envelope with its did:key. The mailbox verifies the pass against the known desk, binds the pass nonce, consumes the request jti and stores the message with a receipt carrying via. Idempotent on worker DID plus TID.

signature.description: Base64url ES256 by the pass's worker key over the request signing bytes.

errors.name: Retired
errors.description: The recipient name is retired. Nothing was admitted.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Input, envelope or sender does not match the pass.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Request audience, method, lifetime, jti or signature refused.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Desk, pass, scope or run refused.

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: The same worker DID plus TID exists with a different envelope or recipient.

errors.name: MailboxUnavailable
errors.description: Durable admission not confirmed; retry the same envelope with a freshly signed request.
